description: Turn any identifier the seller gives — an order or line id, AWB / tracking number, ASIN, FSN, SKU, EAN, invoice number, settlement id or record id — into canonical refs (zbx:…), each with what it matched on, its channel and seller account, and directly related refs. Start here when you have an id but not its channel; then call get_related or get_entity with a ref.

identifier.description: The id exactly as the seller gave it.

seller.description: Restrict to one seller account id.

name: resolve_entity
title: Resolve an identifier
